findings.description: The implementation uses str.lower() for case-insensitive comparison, but the contract requires full Unicode case folding (name.casefold() == stripped_query.casefold()). This will produce incorrect results for certain Unicode characters that have special casefold mappings.
findings.evidence: candidate.py lines 2-5 show use of .lower() on both query and names, which does not satisfy the full Unicode case folding requirement.

review.summary: Candidate uses str.lower() instead of Unicode casefold, violating the contract for full case-insensitive matching.
